earlier_artificial_cut_probe.scope: Staged source diagnostics, not a paired full-corpus baseline.

v4_classification_profile.caveat: Native queries are an ambiguity-selected subset; their mean cost cannot predict all-point cost.

regression_checks.count_note: C++ checks and Python test cases are different units; no invented combined total.

three_ulp_v3.reason: Mismatched interface/library probe; output before abnormal exit is not accepted evidence.

excluded_evidence.prototype_v1: Rejected prototype: 8 new curve refusals on CAD13 and 4 on CAD27; superseded by qualified v2.

cost_accounting.scope: All 8 corpus volume trials retained, including failed versions; rejected and mismatched diagnostic costs retained separately. Build and test time excluded. Historical 600-second baselines were not rerun.

historical_v5_scope.note: One local validated STEP mesh outside 90 seconds does not update the 51-file score.

scope.historical_evidence: Existing v5 and earlier pilot records are retained under their original labels; historical_v5_scope describes those pilots only.

historical_v5_remaining_gaps: CAD03: valid volume outside 90 seconds; low-quality tetrahedra remain and ray witnesses dominate measured material classification.
CAD13: crossing chart constraints and nonmanifold fallback source.

counting.internal_route_attempt_costs: Included in each Native/API and enclosing clock, including failures; nested stages are not added again.
counting.native_call: API mesh call, including internal retries; not import or independent file inspection.
counting.import_mesh_export: STEP import plus mesh call plus archive export; independent inspection excluded.
counting.controller_process: Controller-observed worker process wall time including launch/import/export/inspection; worker-reported time is separate.
counting.unknown_clocks: Remain unknown, including import refusals and interrupted processes; never inferred to be zero.
counting.actual_work_scope: 256 generation attempts:204 screens,12 held-out requests,40 fixed-slow repeats. All failure costs retained. Separate inspection-only work counted once per actual audit, plus verification overhead; orchestration wall time is not added to its children.
counting.controller_90_cost_scope: Per-case qualification charges the complete referenced audit even when a byte-identical proof is reused. Shared proof reuse cannot create a new fast meshing success.

independent_followup.native_and_source_binding: Each original attempt retains its own accepted CAD/source/native snapshot, archive identity and expected body/face tags. Shared numerical proofs match exact archive bytes, parser/metric module hashes, limits, options, runner and Python identity.
independent_followup.preserved_costs: Original failed inspection and complete referenced audit cost are charged per case. Aggregate actual audit work is counted once; verification overhead is retained. Native and import/mesh/export clocks do not change.
independent_followup.resume: Failed final summary rename was resumed using the same completed individual receipts; no repeated audit or remeshing.

interpretation.inspection_only_gain_explanation: Both binaries already passed Native gates; only the candidate finished the original short inspection. Extended inspection now qualifies both. This was never new meshing coverage.
interpretation.quality: Native acceptance does not certify simulation suitability; CAD27 retains extremely poor positive cells.

heldouts.scope: Preselected held-outs, one previously qualified. Two first executed this iteration failed; no universal or wholly-unseen qualification claim.

fixed_slow_comparison.scope: Three-run descriptive medians only for six independently qualified matched attempts. Identical recorded archive SHA, requested/effective settings, achieved sizing, CAD errors, routes and tags checked. Refusal durations are not valid-mesh speedups; failed costs remain in256attempt totals.

query_tool_reuse_pilot.scope: Separate CLI experiment with identical archive and CAD-error signatures. Every validation sample retained; no default change or corpus-wide speed claim. CLI and Python timing policies remain separate.

post_matrix_followup.scope: Diagnostics-only follow-up; not the frozen matrix binary.

document_preparation.source: Bounded numerical JSON, completed independent proof receipts and metric summaries, and12 held-out controller receipts. No archive or binary rereads and no downloaded CAD/figures redistributed.

descriptive_crossmode_union.scope: Union of two separately executed profiles; neither profile passes34files and no automatic selection/runtime result is established.

source_patch.change: Bounded original-CAD facet projection plus identity-aware swept-patch remapping, retaining all subsequent source/contact/material/volume audits.
source_patch.result: CAD27 newly accepted in the experimental profile; very poor positive cells remain.

chart_recovery.change: Canonical shared-curve interval refinement retains common nodes and original trim membership.
chart_recovery.result: Improved recovery is not permission to accept inconsistent original trim data; CAD13 remains refused.

core_cleanup.change: Bounded source coverage diagnostics, local retained-mesh continuation, exact-bit trim memoization and reduced duplicate original-CAD work.
core_cleanup.result: Source-first early probing remains Advanced-only; no default performance improvement is claimed for that schedule. Experimental CAD03 retains recorded mesh identity while its Native call decreases.

remaining_gaps: Default coverage remains 30/51 and experimental coverage 33/51 after independent inspection; the 34/51 within 90 seconds target is unmet.
CAD13 and other initial-front, surface and recovery failures remain; a descriptive cross-profile union of 34 is not an automatic dispatcher or runtime result.
CAD27 passes at 93.71 Native seconds but retains extremely poor positive tetrahedra; validity is not solver adequacy.
The fixed five-case cohort did not qualify across all repeats; no full-cohort median or halving claim can be made.
No installed-wheel, cross-platform, universal STEP or simulation-adequacy claim follows from this development qualification.
